text: This whole memorial was built in honour of
— a moderator, a friend, a wonderful person to talk to and the brightest soul I have ever known.
It is hard to write this, but this memorial means only one thing: he has passed away. The irreparable happened on 14.07.
To mark 40 days since his death, this memorial was built by:
There was also... let's call it an event. Many people gathered to remember him with a kind word. Some came to support the others.
